exception_type: Later Closed Won opportunities would restart existing accounts
treatment: Use the earliest Closed Won opportunity to establish account go-live. Later expansions or renewals do not restart the 90-day new-customer window.

exception_type: AE credit recognized outside employment dates
treatment: Pay individual AE credit only when the AE was employed on the recognition date. Preserve post-termination manager carry where the plan explicitly requires it.

exception_type: Closed Won account has no AE owner
treatment: Do not reassign a missing opportunity owner. Keep the credit unassigned and flag it for review.
Ignore closed_won_date where opportunity_stage is not Closed Won. Opportunity stage governs.
Document the mismatch between the message extract and its accompanying summary; retain the raw extract for review.
